queries.gaia_tap: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, pmra, pmdec, phot_g_mean_mag, ref_epoch FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE source_id = 743972413947537664
queries.irsa_tap_coverage: SELECT a.uri, p.energy_bandpassname, p.time_bounds_lower, p.time_bounds_upper, p.provenance_version FROM spherex.artifact a JOIN spherex.plane p ON a.planeid = p.planeid WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', 149.81969618, 29.94689082), p.poly) ORDER BY p.time_bounds_lower
